note: group waves is the closest by atlas labels (motion & waves); the page is thermal physics

description.zh: 二维硬圆盘气体：压强是大量分子撞墙的冲量平均，温度是平均动能——把气球放进热水，分子撞得更猛更快，气球就胀大；分子互相碰撞、不断交换能量，自然生成麦克斯韦速率分布，不用事先设定。不是三维真实气体。
description.en: A 2D hard-disc gas: pressure is the average impulse of many molecules hitting the walls, temperature is mean kinetic energy — warm a balloon and its molecules hit harder and faster, so it swells. Collisions keep swapping energy and naturally generate the Maxwell speed distribution, nothing preset. Not a real 3D gas.

reason.zh: 温度被读作粒子平均动能，压强由撞墙冲量算出。
reason.en: Temperature is read as mean kinetic energy and pressure comes from wall impulses.

label.zh: 速率分布来自随机碰撞
label.en: Random collisions shape the speed distribution

reason.zh: 大量粒子的随机碰撞让速率分布趋向固定形状，个别粒子不可预测。
reason.en: Random collisions among many particles drive the speed distribution to a fixed shape while single particles stay unpredictable.

reason.zh: 压强读数的涨落随撞墙次数增多而变小，与蒙特卡洛的 1/√n 同类。
reason.en: Pressure readings fluctuate less as wall hits accumulate, the same 1/√n behaviour as Monte Carlo estimates.

title.en: Where do pressure and temperature come from?

ask.zh: 压强是撞墙冲量——分子撞墙越猛、越频繁，压强越大还是越小？
ask.en: Pressure is wall impulse — harder, more frequent wall collisions: bigger or smaller pressure?

ask.zh: 温度是平均动能——温度升高，分子的平均动能怎样变？速率分布的形状怎样变？
ask.en: Temperature is mean kinetic energy — as temperature rises, how does mean kinetic energy change? How does the speed distribution's shape change?

ask.zh: 碰撞怎样生成麦克斯韦速率分布？分布是事先设定的还是碰撞自然产生的？
ask.en: How do collisions generate the Maxwell speed distribution? Is the distribution preset, or does it emerge from collisions?

reveal.zh: 压强是大量分子撞墙的冲量平均，温度是平均动能；碰撞不断交换能量，自然生成麦克斯韦速率分布。
reveal.en: Pressure is the average impulse of countless wall collisions, temperature is mean kinetic energy; collisions constantly exchange energy and the Maxwell speed distribution emerges on its own.
